newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar slips against dlr to 475/476.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar slips against dlr to 475/476.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar slipped in light trade closing at 475.00/476.00 per dollar as investors bought-back dollars reversing the bolivar's surprise appreciation on Thursday, traders said.
"Trade was much quieter today," said one trader. On Thursday the bolivar strengthened on unusually high dollar sales to close at a strong 474.00/475.25/dollar.
By contrast "the market was dry of dollars today," said one trader, adding that Monday could see the bolivar resume its more normal gentle depreciation.
